question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The solution is **belief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1 is belief.
 
• Science, according to popular belief, is a remote and enigmatic idea that is (2)________ the comprehension of ordinary minds and peace-loving people. This is most likely why the words 'scientist' and 'mad' have been used interchangeably for centuries.
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **B**elief - An acceptance that something exists or is true, especially one without proof.

 
 
• ​*For example : "He believes in ghosts."*
 
 
 
• ***​*Belief** is a **noun **that refers to the act of accepting something as true while **believe **is a **verb **that refers to accepting something as truth.
